corrections.correction: 473,276,430 XRP was an expected minimum at closing in the Aug 27 proxy/prospectus. The Oct 30 S-1 reports approximately 473 million XRP held as of Oct 9. The exact 473,276,430.423935 XRP value below is a calculation from primary-reported components, not a separately stated exact custody balance.

The Oct 13 POS AM identifies 11,499,992 Public Warrants at $11.50. The Oct 30 S-1 separately identifies 239,653 Sponsor Warrants and reports 11,739,645 Pubco Warrants in total. The prior 9,283,847 count was not the current public-warrant count and is superseded.

The tracker’s attributed-wallet balance plus reported outflow totals 473,476,568 XRP, which exceeds the reconstructed primary-source transaction components by approximately 200,138 XRP. This is an unresolved tracker reconciliation difference, not evidence of a sale.
